brief:
Residents of Ramallah are sleeping in their vehicles after Israeli forces closed roads surrounding the city, the Ma'an news agency reported. The blockade has trapped civilians in the area, leaving them unable to return to their homes or travel to other locations.

The road closures have created a humanitarian crisis, with families forced to spend nights in their cars due to the restrictions on movement imposed by Israeli occupation forces.
title: Israeli closure forces Ramallah residents to sleep in cars
